page_title: LIL 3-3 STR | Lille v Strasbourg 21/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+6' The foul by Jeremy Sebas (Strasbourg) was seen by Jerome Brisard who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
90+5' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) has a great chance to score from deep inside the box! He finds some space for the shot, but sends it errantly way past the right post. Very bad attempt.
90+4' The resulting corner from Edon Zhegrova (Lille) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
90+3' Mitchel Bakker (Lille) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. Lille earn a corner.
90+2' Liam Rosenior has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jeremy Sebas (Strasbourg) replacing Emanuel Emegha.
90+2' Tiago Santos (Lille) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' The corner from Edon Zhegrova (Lille) is intercepted by Djordje Petrovic.
90' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Edon Zhegrova (Lille). The ball goes out of play. Lille are awarded a corner kick.
87' Osame Sahraoui (Lille) fires the ball towards goal from just outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar after coming very close to hitting the roof of the net.
87' Tiago Santos (Lille) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
85' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Sekou Mara (Strasbourg) is coming onto the pitch as Sebastian Nanasi cannot continue after picking up an injury.
84' 3 - 3 GOAL! Jonathan David (Lille) takes a real chance, but his low driven penalty into the middle of the net fools Djordje Petrovic in goal.
84' Jonathan David (Lille) is going to take the penalty!
82' Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.

82' It looks like Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg) saw red with that tackle. Jerome Brisard won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. The referee's verdict is crystal clear. A penalty is awarded to Lille!
81' Angel Gomes will be replaced by Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille).
80' The corner from Edon Zhegrova (Lille) is hurriedly cleared.

80' Tiago Santos (Lille) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. Lille will have a chance to score from a corner.
80' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

79' A cross from Tiago Santos (Lille) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Lille will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
79' The corner by Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.

79' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger. Strasbourg have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

78' Great chance! Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) collects a great pass inside the box, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort. The referee blows his whistle, Strasbourg are awarded a corner kick.
76' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Lucas Chevalier makes a great save.
75' Angel Gomes (Lille) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
73' Bruno Genesio decides to make a substitution. Gabriel Gudmundsson will be replaced by Mitchel Bakker (Lille).
73' A substitution has been made. Remy Cabella goes off and Mohamed Bayo (Lille) comes on.
73' Here comes a substitution. Abakar Sylla (Strasbourg) is brought on as a substitute for Mamadou Sarr.
73' Liam Rosenior prepares a substitution. Andrey Santos is replaced by Junior Mwanga (Strasbourg).
73' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg) comes onto the pitch so that Diego Moreira can be given a rest.
70' Jerome Brisard shows a yellow card to Bafode Diakite (Lille) for his blatant foul.
69' Lille are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
67' Bruno Genesio has decided to substitute Andre Gomes and he is replaced by Osame Sahraoui (Lille).
67' Substitution. Thomas Meunier leaves the pitch and is replaced by Tiago Santos (Lille).
66' 2 - 3 Goal! Emanuel Emegha tees up Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the bottom left corner. 2:3.
65' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
64' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Benjamin Andre (Lille) was quite harsh and Jerome Brisard didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
64' Remy Cabella (Lille) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
61' Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
60' Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) picks up an injury.
58' Celebrations are cut short for Strasbourg as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review due to a foul in the build-up play.
58' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible foul. The Strasbourg players aren’t happy.

56' Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) jumped highest inside the box to meet a perfectly executed corner kick by Sebastian Nanasi. His header bounced off the ground and went inside the left post behind the goalkeeper. It's 2:3.

56' Lucas Chevalier was forced into action to thwart Guela Doue (Strasbourg). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the right post but couldn't beat the keeper. It will be a corner kick for Strasbourg.
56' Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
55' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
55' The resulting corner from Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) is cleared.
54' Strasbourg are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
51' Flag goes up against Jonathan David (Lille) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.

51' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) blows a clear opportunity to score a goal. He was one-on-one with Lucas Chevalier inside the six-yard box and attempted to put the ball into the left side of the target, but was denied by a great save.
48' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) picks up a pass and unleashes a strong shot from inside the box directed towards the right post, but the goalkeeper is equal to it!
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' Jerome Brisard has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+4' Benjamin Andre (Lille) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
45+4' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Andre Gomes (Lille).
45+3' The resulting corner from Edon Zhegrova (Lille) is cleared by the defence.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
45' The linesman signals that Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.

42' 2 - 2 A perfect lofted pass from Diego Moreira finds Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg), who jumps highest and steers a close-range header straight into the top left corner. His effort was both strong and precise, and Lucas Chevalier had no chance of stopping that. 2:2.

41' Strasbourg are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
40' Lille have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

38' Remy Cabella (Lille) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom left corner. However, Djordje Petrovic anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
37' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
36' Remy Cabella (Lille) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
35' Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
34' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
30' 2 - 1 Goal! Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) slots the ball into an unguarded net from close range after a shot rebounds off a defender. 2:1.

30' What a wasted opportunity by Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg)! He creates himself some space inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the left side of the goal, but Lucas Chevalier makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
29' Remy Cabella (Lille) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
27' 2 - 0 Edon Zhegrova (Lille) is first to latch onto the rebound near the penalty spot, and he produces a fantastic header which goes inside the left post.
26' Angel Gomes (Lille) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
25' Angel Gomes (Lille) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
25' Looks like Angel Gomes (Lille) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
25' The referee blows his whistle as Angel Gomes (Lille) was too aggressive in his challenge.
23' Angel Gomes (Lille) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
22' Dangerous play by Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille). Jerome Brisard blows his whistle for a foul.
19' The corner is swung in but Lille can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
15' 1 - 0 Goal! Edon Zhegrova (Lille) takes a short pass from Angel Gomes in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
14' The Strasbourg players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
12' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
11' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
10' Lille keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
7' Saidou Sow (Strasbourg) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jerome Brisard had an easy-decision to make.
5' The ball is cleared after Jonathan David (Lille) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
5' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Strasbourg.
5' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
3' Jonathan David (Lille) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Lille will take the kick-off.
Jerome Brisard was nominated as the referee for this game.
